label: Handling
description: How the controls feel: the first thing a player notices about a unit.

terms.label: Strafe
terms.description: Moves in any direction regardless of facing and turns instantly; the twin-stick default.

terms.label: Pivot (tank controls)
terms.description: Turns the hull on the spot, then drives forward or back; can't strafe.

terms.label: Steer
terms.description: Turns only while moving, in arcs; fast on straights, can't turn in place.

terms.label: Drift
terms.description: Keeps momentum and slides through turns; needs room to stop.

terms.label: Forward only
terms.description: Must keep moving forward and turns in wide loops; attacks in passes.
